authority_model.evidence_rule: No repository, component, or product may be called finished, missing, live, or nonexistent without an exact repository, ref, commit SHA, entrypoint, and verification result.
authority_model.preservation_rule: Mark, map, reconcile, and evolve. Do not flatten, overwrite, or delete valid implementation lanes.

readiness_states.verified_operational: Entrypoint and critical flow were executed successfully at the recorded SHA.
readiness_states.implemented_unverified: Substantive implementation exists, but current runtime verification is not recorded.
readiness_states.implemented_fragmented: Substantive implementation exists across more than one repository or lane and requires explicit adapter/reconciliation work.
readiness_states.degraded: Implementation exists, but a known blocker prevents a critical path from being represented as operational.
readiness_states.not_audited: No conclusion is permitted until the canonical source is inspected.
readiness_states.local_only: Canonical work is known to exist outside the connected GitHub default branch and must be reconciled without deletion.

empire_1.name: Empire-1
empire_1.role: Umbrella ecosystem and public commercial front door
verified_evidence: backend/app/routers/sla113_orchestration.py exists and exposes the SLA113 orchestration API
backend/app/routers/revenue_os.py exists and implements Revenue OS routes, records, pipeline, checkout, receipts, and analytics
backend/services/money_pipeline_engine.py exists and invokes an LLM-backed structured revenue pipeline
known_blockers: backend/app/routers/sla113_orchestration.py imports backend/app/engines/sla113/sla113_orchestration_engine.py, which is absent on the audited main ref
Revenue OS can continue with deterministic builders when the AI engine fails, without making fallback mode sufficiently prominent
MoneyPipelineEngine still contains a Gemini provider configuration, which violates the current no-Google/no-Gemini doctrine

sla113.name: SLA113
sla113.role: Parent control plane plus exportable white-label runtime
verified_evidence: The core classifies tasks, routes models, executes strategy/plan engines, enforces canon, monitors drift, handles errors, and records execution metadata
backend/routers/engines/core.py exposes core execute, strategy-to-plan, status, log, and health routes
known_blockers: The standalone SLA113 implementation and the embedded Empire-1 SLA113 implementation are not yet governed by one explicit adapter contract
Empire-1 contains an embedded orchestration import that is not satisfied on its audited main ref

revenue_os.name: Empire Revenue OS
revenue_os.role: Revenue diagnosis, offer, outreach, pipeline, checkout, delivery receipt, and analytics module
verified_evidence: The MoneyPipelineEngine makes an LLM call and parses structured JSON output
Revenue OS includes lead records, commands, receipts, pipeline stages, checkout state, delivery receipts, and analytics
known_blockers: The AI engine call catches broad exceptions and returns None
Most customer-visible modules are also built through deterministic string templates
Receipts do not yet make AI mode versus deterministic fallback mode undeniable
Google/Gemini provider configuration must be removed

cultura.name: Cultura Vibe Forge
cultura.role: Cultural authenticity, Soulfire guardrails, and culturally governed creation forge
verified_evidence: backend/server.py is a substantive FastAPI implementation, not an empty scaffold
The backend includes JWT authentication, MongoDB integration, LLM gateway calls, Soulfire guardrails, artifact generation, and execution support
The frontend includes landing, login, dashboard, drafts, artifact view, and layout surfaces
The repository has a multi-commit implementation and deployment history
known_blockers: Current deployment and end-to-end runtime health were not executed during this evidence pass
Required environment configuration must be verified before representing the product as operational

forbidden_conclusions: Missing from one repository means nonexistent everywhere
A route or UI proves its imported engine exists
Generated output proves the AI path executed
Folders or filenames prove runtime readiness
